maddeler.e:
أتأقلم (form IIq)
# أَتَأَقْلَمُ (ʔataʔaqlamu) /ʔa.ta.ʔaq.la.mu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَأَقْلَمَ (taʔaqlama)
# أَتَأَقْلَمَ (ʔataʔaqlama) /ʔa.ta.ʔaq.la.ma/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَأَقْلَمَ (taʔaqlama)
# أَتَأَقْلَمْ (ʔataʔaqlam) /ʔa.ta.ʔaq.lam/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَأَقْلَمَ (taʔaqlama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
